module.name: holoscan-pcl-filters
module.description: Point-cloud filters on the GPU for holoscan-messages PointCloud messages, organized or not, carrying their colors, normals and intensities: a deterministic voxel grid (centroid or first point, mean fields), a crop box and pass-through or range filter with an optional transform, RANSAC ground removal with the plane's coefficients (or a height threshold), and statistical or radius outlier removal over a GPU grid. Clouds keep their shape, removed points NaN, or come out packed, with a host wait or padded without one.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.
